svg.title: TexJEPA: asymmetric latent prediction, model lineage, and evaluation
svg.desc: A schematic chest image splits into a corrupted visible-context branch and a clean full-image EMA target branch. Target patches are removed before context-encoder attention. The predictor uses visible context features and target queries with positions. Clean target features are normalized and selected, with stop-gradient, for block-averaged Smooth-L1 prediction. The context encoder updates the target encoder by EMA. TexJEPA-C adds variance and covariance losses on visible context patch tokens before the predictor. TexJEPA-R and TexJEPA-C branch independently from TexJEPA-N at epoch 50. Evaluation distinguishes direct feature drift, probe classification, and classification-aligned lesion occlusion with five matched controls. All chest images are schematic illustrations, not patient data.
